title: Few physicists in the crash-retrieval program
summary: Charles tells of Few physicists in the crash-retrieval program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Like your
last interview pointed out how few
physicists there were for the retrieval
program.

plain: A man named Charles, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, points back to Michels' previous interview, which he says showed how few physicists worked in the secret program said to recover crashed craft that are not of human origin. If true, it would mean a very small scientific team was handling the most important material on Earth.
